title: InterPresure Suggestions
description: Strengths, weaknesses, and suggestions for a translation scope as produced by the InterPresure pragmatic annotation system.

strengths.description: What the translation does well within this scope. Each item is a bullet-pointed markdown string.

weaknesses.description: Areas where the translation falls short within this scope. Each item is a bullet-pointed markdown string.

suggestions.description: Concrete improvement suggestions for this scope. Each item is a bullet-pointed markdown string.
